I read issue #520. Before I can write this up I need to ask you a few things.

1. Which fields should each JSON line contain?
2. What should happen when there is no run history to export?
3. Are #512 and #519 both required before this can start?

Here is my draft in the meantime:

## User Story

As a developer who pipes run history into jq, I want a JSON Lines exporter so that I can filter runs without converting the CSV first.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The exporter works properly for finished runs.
- It is well tested.

## Dependencies

- #512
- #519

Which option do you prefer for selecting the format?

a) A new --format jsonl value
b) A separate command

Recommended: a) because it reuses the existing --format flag.

Once you answer I will create the issue:

gh issue create --title "Add a JSON Lines exporter" --label kairon --body-file draft.md
